# RGB split glitch

Red and blue jump apart in quick, seeded steps, like a misaligned digital signal. Bursts switch on and off at most 1.5 times a second, well under the WCAG flash threshold, and only shift channels rather than flashing brightness.

<EffectDemo effect="rgb-split-glitch" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { rgbSplitGlitch } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/rgb-split-glitch';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(rgbSplitGlitch({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.amount = 0.008`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type                 | Default    | Range     | Description                                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------- | ---------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `amount`      | number               | `0.008`    | 0 – 0.06  | Channel offset as a fraction of the frame height.           |
| `angle`       | number               | `0`        | 0 – 360 ° | Direction of the split.                                     |
| `jitter`      | number               | `0.6`      | 0 – 1     | How much the offset and angle vary from step to step.       |
| `rate`        | number               | `8`        | 1 – 20 /s | Jitter steps per second.                                    |
| `trigger`     | 'bursts' \| 'always' | `'bursts'` |           | Bursts glitch in random windows; always keeps the split on. |
| `burstChance` | number               | `0.35`     | 0 – 1     | Bursts mode: the fraction of windows that glitch.           |
| `seed`        | integer              | `1`        | 0 – 9999  | Changes the random sequence.                                |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                        |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`    | `amount: 0.003`, `jitter: 0.3`, `burstChance: 0.2`              |
| `broadcast` | `amount: 0.012`, `jitter: 0.8`, `rate: 12`, `burstChance: 0.5`  |
| `constant`  | `trigger: 'always'`, `amount: 0.006`, `jitter: 0`               |
| `diagonal`  | `trigger: 'always'`, `amount: 0.01`, `angle: 45`, `jitter: 0.4` |

Apply one with `rgbSplitGlitch({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`jitter: 0`, `trigger: 'always'`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/rgb-split-glitch`, including the shared effect runtime.
